name: FireworksRecipes
description: Fireworks 配方目录。每条对应一个可一键安装并发布到 DGX Spark 集群的模型配方；nodes 为固定拓扑，发布时必须恰好匹配。
description_en: Fireworks recipe catalog. Each entry is a model recipe you can install and publish to a DGX Spark cluster with one click; nodes declare a fixed topology you must match exactly.

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash 双节点 TP=2 DSpark 服务：Anemll 分发镜像、FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机、NVFP4 DS-MLA、1M 上下文。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash: Anemll distribution image, FlashInfer b12x + dspark speculation, NVFP4 DS-MLA, 1M context.
recipes.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash MiaAI-Lab

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 双节点 TP=2 DSpark 服务：Anemll 分发镜像、原生图片输入（ViT+Aligner 启动热修复，OpenAI image_url ≤8 张/仅 user 消息/无视频）、FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机 k=6、NVFP4 DS-MLA、1M 上下文。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp: Anemll distribution image, native image input (ViT+Aligner startup hotfix, OpenAI image_url up to 8/user messages only/no video), FlashInfer b12x + dspark speculation k=6, NVFP4 DS-MLA, 1M context.
recipes.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp MiaAI-Lab

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 四节点 TP=4 DSpark 服务：Anemll 分发镜像、FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机 k=5、NVFP4 DS-MLA、1M 上下文（agentic 工作负载实机验证）。
recipes.description_en: 4-node TP=4 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: Anemll distribution image, FlashInfer b12x + dspark speculation k=5, NVFP4 DS-MLA, 1M context (verified on a real agentic workload).
recipes.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash DSpark TP=4

recipes.description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 双节点 TP=2 Spark-vLLM 服务：eugr/spark-vllm-b12x 镜像、B12X MLA SPARSE 注意力 + b12x MoE/线性层、dspark 投机 k=5、FP8 KV 缓存、instanttensor 加载 + AOT 编译、1M 上下文。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 Spark-vLLM serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: eugr/spark-vllm-b12x image, B12X MLA SPARSE attention + b12x MoE/linear, dspark speculation k=5, FP8 KV cache, instanttensor load with AOT compile, 1M context.
recipes.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash Spark-vLLM b12x

recipes.description: Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 单节点 SGLang 服务：lmsysorg/sglang 镜像、flashinfer 注意力、DSPARK 投机解码（mamba 草稿模型）、FP8 KV、--mamba-full-memory-ratio 11.01（疑似笔误，待验证）。
recipes.description_en: Single-node SGLang serving for Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4: lmsysorg/sglang image, flashinfer attention, DSPARK speculation (mamba draft model), FP8 KV, --mamba-full-memory-ratio 11.01 (suspected typo, to verify).
recipes.name: Qwen3.8-27B SGLang DSPARK

recipes.params: 176.9B（51.2B PLE 表 NVMe 流式）/ NVFP4
recipes.description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（176.9B，51.2B n-gram/PLE 查找表由 NVMe 流式加载）单节点 vLLM 服务：RadixArk NVFP4 checkpoint、MTP 训练草稿头 k=3 投机、PIECEWISE CUDA-graph（PLE 查表为 split op）、前缀缓存默认开、262,144 原生上下文、多模态 0.967；~32 tok/s、prefill ~2,030-2,460 tok/s（源自 0xBakeer longctx 路线，dev：镜像待烘焙）。
recipes.description_en: Single-node vLLM serving for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (176.9B, 51.2B n-gram/PLE lookup table streamed from NVMe): RadixArk NVFP4 checkpoint, MTP trained-draft k=3 speculation, PIECEWISE CUDA-graph (PLE gather as a splitting op), prefix caching on by default, full 262,144 native context, multimodal 0.967; ~32 tok/s, prefill ~2,030-2,460 tok/s (from the 0xBakeer longctx lane, dev: image to be baked).
recipes.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next（单节点 vLLM）

recipes.description: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio（Int4-Int8Mix unpruned）四节点 TP=4 + DCP4 服务：AEON v0.27.1 平台镜像 + b12x + spark-kit 生产 overlay（B12X MLA SPARSE + a2a + MTP k=2 + nvfp4_ds_mla + 315,968 上下文）。
recipes.description_en: 4-node TP=4 + DCP4 serving for GLM-5.2 QuantTrio (Int4-Int8Mix unpruned): AEON v0.27.1 platform image + b12x + spark-kit production overlays (B12X MLA SPARSE + a2a + MTP k=2 + nvfp4_ds_mla + 315,968 context).
recipes.name: GLM-5.2 QuantTrio DCP4

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 量化四节点 TP=4 服务（Lane A — fp8 KV，FlashInfer SM12x unlock；原生 MTP k=4 投机）：ACR 烘焙 sm121-v8 镜像（上游 8 层 patch 链）、fp8_e4m3 KV（24GiB/rank）、默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）、1,048,576 上下文、~3.9M token KV 池、结构化解码 ~55 tok/s（实测）。注意：上游把 MTP TP4 标记为 superseded（DFlash2 更快且 KV 池成本 ~0），新部署建议直接改用 DFlash2 配方。
recipes.description_en: 4-node TP=4 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) NVFP4 quant — Lane A fp8 KV (FlashInfer SM12x unlock) with native MTP k=4 speculation: ACR-baked sm121-v8 image (upstream 8-layer patch chain), fp8_e4m3 KV (24 GiB/rank), default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption), 1,048,576 context, ~3.9M-token KV pool, ~55 tok/s structured decode (measured). Note: upstream has marked MTP TP4 as superseded (DFlash2 is faster at ~zero KV-pool cost) — new deployments should use the DFlash2 recipe instead.
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 Lane A

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 量化四节点 TP=4 服务（上游当前默认配置：fp8 KV + DFlash2 k=7 块扩散投机）：ACR 烘焙 v11-dflash2 镜像（上游 v1→v9 patch 栈 + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer 模块烘焙）、fp8_e4m3 KV（每 rank 24GiB = 3,895,606-token 池，3.72× 满 1M）、默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）、1,048,576 上下文；2026-08-29 gate 通过：单流 54.5 tok/s、prefill 4,141.8 tok/s。
recipes.description_en: 4-node TP=4 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) on the upstream current default config (fp8 KV + DFlash2 k=7 block-diffusion spec decode): ACR-baked v11-dflash2 image (upstream v1→v9 patch stack + DFlash2 overlay + SM121 indexer module baked in), fp8_e4m3 KV (24 GiB/rank = 3,895,606-token pool, 3.72x a full 1M), default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption), 1,048,576 context; gate-passed 2026-08-29 at 54.5 tok/s single-stream and 4,141.8 tok/s prefill.
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 DFlash2

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE，glm5_next）NVFP4 双节点 TP=2 服务（fp8 KV + DFlash2 块扩散投机）：上游「the one to copy」档位——C1–C6 并发扫描零失败、warm 单流 46.9 tok/s（74.1% 接受率，结构化 54–61 tok/s）、262,144 上下文、--max-num-batched-tokens 8192（上游 2026-08-30 pin，TP4 实测 C4 并发 +57%，与拓扑无关）、KV 让 profiler 定池（581,040-token，勿 pin）；v11-dflash2 镜像（与 TP4 DFlash2 同链烘焙）+ 默认 RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint（compressed-tensors，修复 ModelOpt token 损坏）。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE, glm5_next) NVFP4 quant — fp8 KV + DFlash2 block-diffusion spec decode, the upstream 'the one to copy' tier: C1-C6 concurrency sweep with zero failures, warm single-stream 46.9 tok/s (74.1% acceptance; 54-61 tok/s structured), 262,144 context, max-num-batched-tokens 8192 (upstream 2026-08-30 pin, +57% C4 aggregate at TP4, topology-agnostic), KV pool profiler-sized (581,040 tokens — do not pin); v11-dflash2 image (same bake chain as the TP4 DFlash2 recipe) + default RedHatAI/GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 checkpoint (compressed-tensors, fixes ModelOpt token corruption).
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 DFlash2 TP=2

recipes.description: GLM-5.3-Flash（320B/A18B MoE）双节点 TP=2 EXL3/TR3 服务：Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw 权重镜像、fp8_ds_mla KV、DFlash2 k=7 投机（drafter 跨 TP 分片）、MNBT 2048（上游 2026-08-29 P1 keep，冷 prefill +3–16%）、1M 上下文（padded slot-share）、Vision 默认开——ACR 烘焙镜像（上游现行 Dockerfile @493cb88，5 个运行时补丁全量入镜像）；decode 单流 62.9 tok/s（×2 聚合 103.3 / ×4 聚合 146.5）。
recipes.description_en: 2-node TP=2 EXL3/TR3 serving for GLM-5.3-Flash (320B/A18B MoE): Mia-AiLab uniform-K4 4bpw weight mirror, fp8_ds_mla KV, DFlash2 k=7 speculation (drafter sharded across TP), MNBT 2048 (upstream 2026-08-29 P1 keep, +3-16% cold prefill), 1M context (padded slot-share), Vision on by default — ACR-baked image (upstream current Dockerfile @493cb88, all five runtime patches baked in); 62.9 tok/s single-stream (x2 aggregate 103.3 / x4 aggregate 146.5).
recipes.name: GLM-5.3-Flash EXL3 TP=2
